title.rendered: Psiphon Pro Lite Handler Apk Download

content.rendered:
Download Psiphon pro lite handler for all versions of android phones which connects faster than any other handler available.

The pro lite handler by odiseo, is very small in size, which is around 2.90MB. It comes with normal handler functionality, the developer really tried , a big thanks to him for this wonderful work he did, because this app does not takes too much space on your phone.

Some of the popular  features available on  Psiphon pro lite handler are:

– Remove Port

– Proxy Type

– Proxy Server

– Real Proxy Server

– Real Proxy Type

– Port.

Download Link

➡ Psiphon Pro lite Handler.apk

Psiphon Pro lite Handler Settings

1. Install and open pro lite handler.
2, Tick Remove Port.
3. Proxy Type: Real Host or Dual Host.
4. Proxy Server: e.g 0.facebook.com or any website that your ISP allows you to access for free.
5. Port : 80 and click ok to Save.
6. Tick tunnel whole device.
7. Select any server or leave it for Psiphon to automatically select best servers for you and click start to connect.8. Give Pro lite permission by clicking ok from the dialogue box that popped up.
